title: Stabilize metadata + docs for newly onboarded models and publish performance signatures
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Produce finalized catalog metadata and end-user docs for three recently onboarded models (Cerebrum-XL, Artemis-7B, and Nimbus-13B), publish standardized performance signatures, and implement conservative version-pinning guidance so customers get predictable behavior across hosted/dedicated/private deployments.

Scope: metadata fields (architecture, parameters, quantization variants, supported sequence lengths, K/V cache shapes, runtime_compat tags), canonical benchmark numbers (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, mem-peak for standard batch sizes), rollout docs for Console and API consumers, and an operational playbook for pinning/rollbacks. This ticket does NOT include kernel-level runtime changes; it is focused on catalog entries, documentation, and release notes.

Why now: The engineering onboarding run uncovered three sources of user confusion: (1) unclear variant naming leading to mismatched fallback choices, (2) missing explicit runtime compatibility markers for quantized formats, and (3) lack of published performance signatures, which prevents customers from making cost/latency tradeoffs. Publishing this standardized metadata and docs reduces support load and avoids silent regressions during model swaps or autoscale events.

Deliverables:
- Canonical catalog JSON entries for Cerebrum-XL, Artemis-7B, Nimbus-13B with standardized field names.
- Performance signature files (.perf) uploaded to the model index with benchmark harness links.
- 'Model onboarding checklist' section in the internal docs (Confluence) with step-by-step verification items.
- Console doc updates that expose the pinning UI helper text and recommended pin policies.
- A short runbook for ops on how to rollback a pinned variant if latency regressions are detected.

Out-of-scope: API surface changes, Dedicated autoscaler implementation, or changes to quantization toolchains.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog entries for Cerebrum-XL, Artemis-7B, Nimbus-13B committed to model-index repo and validated by linting job
Performance signatures published and linked from the catalog entry (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, mem-peak for batch sizes 1/4/16)
Docs updated: internal onboarding checklist, public Console helper text, and changelog entry for catalog-2026.03
Pinning guidance written and approved by runtime and product (explicit stable pin vs patch float examples)
QA signoff: two runtime regression checks pass on runtime-1.22 (small traffic smoke test)

runbook_notes: If p95 increases by >20% after deployment, revert the pin to previous digest and open ENG-42771-rollback with stack traces.
For quantized variants, use runtime_compat tag 'q8-compat' or 'q4-compat' to avoid mismatched kernel selection.
When publishing perf signatures, include exact hardware spec, driver version, and harness commit hash to ensure reproducibility.
